g.text: Predicting a conversion and changing a conversion are different tasks

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b6873

g.text: Predictive metrics use each model’s m1; causal policies rank m1 − m0. Conversion and tree uplift share m1 in this run.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5b6873

g.text: High-response audiences may also convert without assignment. Only the assignment contrast measures incrementality.
